en:
<CLT=cltMIND>The elevator stopped, and
just like always...
<CLT=cltMIND>...the doors parted slowly.

<CLT=cltMIND>The light that shines on us from the
other side, the bright light of our future.
<CLT=cltMIND>Or, is it—

Boy, they look really depressed. Must be
cuz there's even less participants now.

Don't say they look depressed!
You'll make Monodam sad!

Puhuhu... As much as I'd love to keep
hearing this adorable back-and-forth...
Let's hurry up and get this started!

At last, the class trial will begin! I hope
you enjoy it to your heart's content!

<CLT=cltMIND>The third class trial was
about to begin.
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie Yonaga, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Artist<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>She created the Ultimate Academy Student
Council to try to prevent the killing game.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then, Tenko Chabashira, the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Aikido Master<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>She hated men, but I knew that she hated
this terrible killing game even more.

<CLT=cltMIND>The two who were killed were both trying
to stop the killing.
<CLT=cltMIND>And who was the one who killed them?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was it one person?
<CLT=cltMIND>Two different people?

<CLT=cltMIND>We need to pin that down
in this class trial.
<CLT=cltMIND>In order to live...we have to find the truth!
<CLT=cltMIND>...And I will fight for it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I will fight with truth and lies
in this class trial!
